integrity: The proof derives an exact boundary logarithmic-derivative identity from the factorizations of p and p-prime, retains the full nonnegative radial defect term, and applies Cauchy--Schwarz. Equality is reconstructed from the equality conditions and the disk containment of a translated regular polygon is checked exactly. No numerical computation is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to simple distinguished zeros on the unit circle. It does not refine the interior-zero case of the full quadratic Tang--Zhang theorem. The historical boundary Sendov literature is extensive, so a differently phrased older equivalent remains a residual literature risk despite targeted comparisons.
title: Sharp radial-defect strengthening of the boundary Tang--Zhang inequality
